item.title: French Navy Seizes 4.2 Tonnes of Cocaine in French Polynesia
item.description: The French Navy seized 4.249 tonnes of cocaine from a ship intercepted in French Polynesia, local authorities announced on Wednesday, confirming earlier reports by local broadcaster TNTV. Authorities said the vessel had departed from Central America and carried 174 packages of cocaine. The ship declared South Africa as its destination.
